hero.title: X4 Abandoned & Derelict Ships and Locations
hero.intro: X4: Foundations is full of abandoned ships, ownerless derelicts just sitting there, from cheap scouts to full destroyers. Fly out, claim them in your spacesuit, and they're yours for free. Below: how claiming works, the best free ships ranked, every known location, and the nine Timelines reward ships (TL1 to TL9).
hero.map_cta: See every free ship on the interactive X4 sector map

ranking.label: The Shortlist
ranking.title: The best free, derelict & abandoned ships in X4: Foundations
ranking.intro: All six are free, but they aren't equal. Here are the abandoned & derelict ships ranked by what you get for the trip, from a full destroyer down to early-game scouts. Select any name for exact coordinates.
ranking.map_prompt: Planning the trip? See every wreck on the interactive X4 sector map and plot a gate-by-gate route from your start sector.

items.odysseus_vanguard: Faulty Logic VII. A full L-class destroyer that spawns fully equipped; since 4.0 HF2 you can claim it solo by spacewalking to the bridge.
items.osprey_vanguard: Company Regard. A free medium frigate and the best low-effort upgrade on the list.
items.drill_vanguard: The Void. A free M-class miner and a useful early mining ship.
items.elite_vanguard: Grand Exchange I. A fast early-game interceptor with a quick spacesuit claim.
items.perseus_vanguard: Silent Witness XII. A free S-class fighter on the ecliptic.
items.courier_vanguard: Nopileos' Fortune II. A free small courier near the highway exit.

claiming.label: The Basics
claiming.title: How to claim a derelict
claiming.scope: Every ship size, S to XL

steps.1: Fly to the ship and stop close to it.
steps.2: Leave your ship and enter your spacesuit (EVA).
steps.3: Press Shift+2, find the red pulsing light on the hull, and repair it. The ship is claimed automatically when the repair is complete.
steps.4: Assign a pilot or fly the ship home yourself.

claiming.how_body: A derelict is ownerless. Repairing the red pulsing light transfers it to you, using the same method for every ship size.
claiming.reset_body: Most ships are available only once per save. Their locations are fixed, but a claimed ship will not respawn there.

content.about_title: The interactive X4 Foundations galaxy map, every sector, all DLCs
content.about_intro: Every sector in the current X4: Foundations galaxy with all expansions installed, Split Vendetta, Cradle of Humanity, Tides of Avarice and Kingdom End. Hexes are coloured by their controlling faction; lines are gate links, dashed lines are super-highways. Click any sector for its faction and connections.
content.about_usage: Use it as a complete X4 sector map and galaxy map: search any system by name, then pan and zoom from the whole galaxy down to a single sector, every base-game and DLC region on one interactive map.
content.about_lenses: Flip on the Derelict Ships lens (top toolbar) to mark every sector with a claimable derelict, pin colour shows the ship's class (S/M/L), and each marker opens its claim notes, coordinates and a link straight to the full derelict ships guide. Click any sector and hit Plan a route here, or use Plan a Route in the top toolbar to pick a start and destination by name, for a gate-by-gate path between any two systems. Xenon sectors on the way are flagged red.
content.resource_notice: Resource data (ore - silicon - ice - gases - scrap) lands after the X4 9.0 update
content.free_ships_title: Free, derelict & abandoned ships in X4: Foundations
content.free_ships_intro: Scattered across the X4 universe are ownerless wrecks, derelict and abandoned ships you can claim for free, from cheap scouts to a full destroyer. Below are the six confirmed locations; turn on the Derelict Ships lens above to see them on the map, then plan a jump-gate route from your start system.
content.free_ships_guide_prompt: Want screenshots and the exact in-sector approach for each wreck? See the full X4 derelict & abandoned ships guide.
content.timeline_intro: Beyond the derelicts, the Timelines DLC hands out nine unique reward ships (TL1 to TL9) scattered across the galaxy. Each one only appears in your save after you complete the matching Timelines scenario. Flip on the Derelict Ships lens above. The same toggle now also shows these in violet, ready to plan a route to.
content.timeline_note: Heads-up: Timeline ships only spawn once you've finished the matching Timelines mission. The in-sector positions are fixed.
content.faq_title: X4 map & free ships, quick answers
content.faq_free_ships_question: Where do I find free ships in X4: Foundations?
content.faq_free_ships_answer: Free, derelict and abandoned ships are ownerless wrecks across the galaxy. Confirmed spots: Grand Exchange I, Silent Witness XII, Nopileos' Fortune II, Company Regard, The Void and Faulty Logic VII. Toggle the Free Ships lens on the map above to see every sector.
content.faq_best_question: What is the best free ship in X4?
content.faq_best_answer: The Odysseus Vanguard, an L-class destroyer in Faulty Logic VII. Since 4.0 HF2 it spawns fully equipped, so you can claim it by spacewalking to the bridge.
content.faq_claim_question: How do I claim a derelict ship in X4?
content.faq_claim_answer: Leave your ship in a spacesuit, fly to the wreck and repair the red pulsing light on the hull. Once repaired the ship is yours. This works the same for every ship size.
content.faq_dlcs_question: Does this X4 map include all DLCs?
content.faq_dlcs_answer: Yes, the full universe with Split Vendetta, Cradle of Humanity, Tides of Avarice and Kingdom End installed, current for the v9.0 sector layout. Resource data (ore, silicon, ice, gases, scrap) follows after the X4 9.0 update.
